title: Taken in broad daylight in 2007
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Taken in broad daylight in 2007, about 2007 at Cape Fear River, North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was in the broad daylight. Then they came and they took me.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man from North Carolina who says he attracts UFOs, says that in 2007, near the Cape Fear River, beings came and took him in broad daylight. He tells the story in his book UFO of God, and if true it would mean he was taken by non-human visitors.
